exposure: Fetoscopic surgery for isolated Congenital Diaphragmatic Hernia (CDH)
Expectant management for isolated Congenital Diaphragmatic Hernia (CDH)
outcome: Complications during delivery or post-partum in subsequent pregnancies
cohort: Women who carried a fetus with isolated Congenital Diaphragmatic Hernia (CDH), divided into those who underwent fetoscopic surgery and those who were managed expectantly.
finding: Fetoscopic surgery for CDH was not associated with an increased risk of future obstetric or gynecological problems or subsequent infertility compared to expectant management.
followup_time: Up to 76 months after the index pregnancy (average 76 months for FETO group, 59 months for controls)
